$comment: Least-privilege UXP manifest v5 template. Start here; add permissions ONLY when the task requires them, and record why in the adjacent $comment. Version facts: see references/current-versions.md — set minVersion to the lowest PS you actually test.
name: CHANGE ME

requiredPermissions.$comment: DELIBERATELY EMPTY BY DEFAULT. Escalation menu — copy in only what you need:

$escalation_notes.localFileSystem: 'request' lets the user pick folders (preferred). 'fullAccess' only for trusted internal tools that must roam — expect Marketplace scrutiny. 'plugin' = sandbox only.
$escalation_notes.network: { "domains": ["https://api.example.com"] } — enumerate exact domains; NO top-level wildcards. Talking to a local daemon? List BOTH http://localhost:PORT and http://127.0.0.1:PORT (known flakiness — see pitfalls-registry).
$escalation_notes.launchProcess: { "schemes": ["https"], "extensions": [".pdf"] } — gates shell.openExternal/openPath; user sees a consent dialog at runtime.
$escalation_notes.clipboard: 'read' or 'readAndWrite' — readAndWrite only if the feature is clipboard-centric.
$escalation_notes.webview: { "domains": ["https://embedded.example.com"], "enableMessageBridge": "localOnly" } — bridge value REQUIRED for postMessage; localAndRemote only when remote pages must message the plugin. Local HTML needs UXP 8.0+ (PS 26+).
$escalation_notes.allowCodeGenerationFromStrings: true only if a dependency demands eval — try to eliminate the dependency first.
$escalation_notes.enableAddon: true only for C++ hybrid builds — brings signing/notarization/tri-arch/admin-install requirements (see hybrid-cpp-and-webview.md).
